Activity follows the turn.

Built from scratch/loo-720.md and scratch/loo720-demo-evidence/. Actual screenshots and configured Claude execution.

Automated behavior acceptance passed. No response is needed to complete this demo. Shipping remains a separate action.

You requested automatic acceptance. The candidate now reports the real Claude turn in Rex and Loopflow Desktop, including the first launch and reconnect. These are agent observations; personal visual feedback has not been inferred.

What the demo caught

  1. Claude’s title-disable setting also suppressed its activity reports. Native titles remain enabled so reports can reach the host.
  2. The retained terminal lost Desktop’s placement marker at its PTY handoff. The validated placement now reaches native admission.
  3. Desktop discarded a restored question arriving before its Session association. The first association now retains that reading; replacement providers start empty.

Before: pane and summary disagreed

After: the same question reaches both places

Runbook and observed results

All actions used disposable conversations. Controlled protocol cases are distinct from provider behavior.

ActionExpectedObserved
Start a native turnWorkingPassed in Rex and Desktop.
Ask a questionBlocked with question metadataAmber/Blue question appeared in both hosts; Desktop pane, stored Session and Task row agreed.
Reconnect while the question is pendingSame unanswered question and BlockedPassed in mounted Desktop, without another prompt.
Answer, then run sleep 15Working throughout silent workPassed in both hosts, followed by Done.
Submit another turnWorking again, then DonePassed in both hosts.
Detach during work, return after completionCurrent Done report and completed answerPassed in Rex; no resubmission.
Emit clear, Error, malformed and nested reportsClear removes; invalid does not replace; nested Working survives root IdlePassed with a separately labeled controlled OSC emitter in both hosts.

Evidence and limits

Rex events record Working → Blocked → Working → Done, then restored Done → Working → Done. Fresh Desktop Session reads match the actual pane and Task-row labels. A standalone watch probe ended after its initial snapshot and is not claimed as transition proof.

Passed: nine native transport tests, the title/rename/reconnect integration test, fourteen Swift Program Status tests, formatting, Clippy and both builds. Delivery still owns the broader gate and CI.

Tested: configured Claude 2.1.318, Rex 0.0.1793377904-ge6592f (API 8), and an isolated candidate Desktop app built from this checkout. No machine-wide installation or live Codex/OpenCode acceptance is claimed.
